description: This file contains functions for parsing Markdown links, link destinations, titles, labels, and image dimensions, specific to the Mattermost project.

methods.name: parseLinkDestination
methods.description: Parses the destination URL or reference in a Markdown link, handling angle brackets and parentheses.

methods.name: parseLinkTitle
methods.description: Parses the title of a Markdown link, handling quotes and parentheses.

methods.name: parseLinkLabel
methods.description: Parses the label text of a Markdown link enclosed in square brackets.

methods.name: parseImageDimensions
methods.description: Parses optional width and height dimensions specified in Markdown image syntax.
